cards.title: Deleting a merged branch
cards.body: Once a branch is merged, `git branch -d <name>` deletes it. Its commits stay safe in `main`.
cards.code:
git init
touch a.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch -c extra
touch b.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Add b"
git switch main
git merge extra
git branch -d extra
git branch

hi.title: Merge ho chuki branch delete karna
hi.body: Branch merge ho jaaye toh `git branch -d <name>` use delete karta hai. Uske commits `main` mein safe rehte hain.

cards.title: Git protects unmerged work
cards.body: `-d` refuses to delete a branch whose commits aren't merged yet, so you can't lose work by accident.

hi.title: Git unmerged kaam ko bachata hai
hi.body: `-d` us branch ko delete karne se mana kar deta hai jiske commits abhi merge nahi hue, taaki galti se kaam na kho jaaye.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Git refuses to delete `extra`. Tap the line that runs too early.
cards.code:
git init
touch a.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Start"
git switch -c extra
touch b.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Add b"
git switch main
git branch -d extra

bug.fix: `extra` is not merged yet, so `-d` protects its work. Run `git merge extra` first, then delete the branch.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Git `extra` ko delete karne se mana karta hai. Us line par tap karo jo bahut jaldi chalti hai.
hi.fix: `extra` abhi merge nahi hui, isliye `-d` uska kaam bachata hai. Pehle `git merge extra` chalao, phir branch delete karo.

check.question: `git branch -d footer` says the branch is "not fully merged". What does that mean?
options: Its commits are not in your current branch yet
check.explanation: Deleting it now would lose those commits, so Git stops you.

hi.question: `git branch -d footer` kehta hai branch "not fully merged" hai. Iska matlab kya hai?
options: Uske commits abhi aapki current branch mein nahi hain
hi.explanation: Abhi delete karne se woh commits kho jaate, isliye Git aapko rok deta hai.

exercise.prompt: `footer` is already merged into `main`. Delete the `footer` branch.
exercise.promptHi: `footer` pehle se `main` mein merge ho chuki hai. `footer` branch delete karo.
